summary: This note is a short plot synopsis of the film Mystic Pizza. It follows two sisters and their friend, who work as waitresses at Mystic Pizza in Mystic, Connecticut, and whose romantic lives drive their coming of age. The note also describes Mystic as a fishing town with a large Portuguese-American population and notes the film's treatment of an Old World work ethic.
one_line: Plot summary of the film Mystic Pizza, about three waitresses in Mystic, Connecticut, coming of age through romance.
key_facts: Mystic Pizza is a film about the coming of age of two sisters and their friend.
The film follows the romantic lives of three main characters.
Kat Arújo is played by Annabeth Gish in the film.
Daisy Arújo is played by Julia Roberts in the film.
Jojo Barbosa is played by Lili Taylor in the film.
Kat Arújo, Daisy Arújo and Jojo Barbosa are waitresses at Mystic Pizza.
Mystic Pizza is owned by Leona, played by Conchata Ferrell.
Mystic Pizza is located in Mystic, Connecticut.
In the film, Mystic is represented as a fishing town.
In the film, Mystic is represented as having a large Portuguese-American population.
The film also touches on an Old World work ethic.
